probes.prompt:
/atlassian-twg-cli:twg-setup Use the twg-setup skill to set up TWG for this user. Scenario: this session runs on Windows in a limited terminal (non-TTY, no post-start input); the recognized host is cursor; the Inspect outcome is already known: twg is not found on PATH or at the standard fallback location. Headless boundary: no network, no real external service, no installs, and no shell execution except the single allowed verifier command below, so the Inspect block is not re-run here.

Follow the skill's limited-terminal rules: do not start an interactive installation and do not execute the installer. Record in twg-setup-handoff.md the exact handoff you would give the user, and give the same handoff in your final response. The handoff must: use the OS installer command for Windows PowerShell, i.e. the two lines `curl.exe -fsSL https://teamwork-graph.atlassian.com/cli/install.ps1 -o "$env:TEMP\twg-install.ps1"` and `powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "$env:TEMP\twg-install.ps1" -Plugin cursor`, placed in a fenced powershell block; carry the host plugin argument -Plugin cursor because the recognized host is cursor; include the sentence When it finishes, reply done.; include no doctor and no other follow-up or twg commands before that; state clearly that the command was not executed in this session; and claim nothing as already installed or connected. Do not narrate the plugin argument or describe attribution or analytics to the user.

Then read the immutable verify_twg_setup.py and run exactly python verify_twg_setup.py using Bash; it validates the handoff record and writes twg-setup-verification.json. Do not modify the verifier or read/write its output file with model tools; the runner inspects it directly. This is the only allowed Bash command, without prefixes, suffixes, redirection or extra shell operations. Final response: give the handoff, report the actual verifier result, and state that the real installation, OAuth login, doctor flow and skill refresh remain untested.

import json
from pathlib import Path

text = Path('twg-setup-handoff.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
line1 = 'curl.exe -fsSL https://teamwork-graph.atlassian.com/cli/install.ps1 -o "$env:TEMP\\twg-install.ps1"'
line2 = 'powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "$env:TEMP\\twg-install.ps1" -Plugin cursor'
assert line1 in text, 'handoff must give the documented Windows installer download line'
assert line2 in text, 'handoff must give the documented PowerShell install line with the host plugin argument'
assert '```powershell' in text, 'installer commands must be handed over in a fenced powershell block'
assert 'When it finishes, reply done.' in text, 'handoff must include the documented done instruction'
low = text.lower()
assert 'not executed in this session' in low, 'handoff must state the command was not executed here'
for claim in ('installed successfully', 'successfully installed', 'installation complete', 'is now installed'):
    assert claim not in low, 'must not claim TWG was installed: ' + claim
for cmd in ('twg doctor', 'twg setup', 'twg login', 'twg skills install'):
    assert cmd not in low, 'no doctor or other twg follow-up command may be handed off before done: ' + cmd
assert '| bash' not in text, 'Windows scenario must use the PowerShell installer, not the Unix variant'
report = {'done_instruction': True, 'fenced_powershell_block': True, 'honest_no_execution': True,
          'host_plugin_argument': True, 'installer_lines_exact': True, 'no_twg_commands': True,
          'no_unix_variant': True}
Path('twg-setup-verification.json').write_bytes((json.dumps(report, sort_keys=True) + '\n').encode('utf-8'))
print('TWG setup handoff: documented limited-terminal installer handoff checks passed; real installation, OAuth login and doctor flow remain untested')
